candidates.title: Kettlebell Renegade Row
candidates.description:
Summary: The Renegade Row is a powerful movement that incorporates your back, core, glutes, and legs. It truly is a full body movement disguised as a simple rowing exercise.

Step 1: Place two kettlebells close to each other

Step 2: Get into a high plank position on top of the kettlebells with a  wider than hip width stance.

Step 3: Keep the tension in your glutes and core throughout the entire movement

Step 4: Plant yourself into one bell and row with the other bringing your elbow up towards your hip. Bring the bell down slowly and repeat on the other side.

Tips and Safety: Maintain a long spine throughout the movement without rotation, leaning, or bending. Keep a straight line from your feet through the top of your head. Focus on the hand that’s planted rather than the hand your rowing to maintain a more solid foundation.
